# War Scroll Column 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 14 | **Condition:** complete

---

**14:1** Praise the God of Israel, who called us into His covenant and refused to assign us to the assembly of liars!

**14:2** He placed us among those who belong to truth. He taught us to walk by the standards of righteousness, and through the verdicts of His truth

**14:3** He made us wise. The rage of the wicked will never shake us, and the tests they bring will never make us afraid. For You,

**14:4** O God, are awe-inspiring in the splendor of Your reign. Your holy assembly stands in our midst as our everlasting strength. We look down on kings with contempt

**14:5** and mock the mighty. For the Lord is holy, and the King of Glory fights alongside us, His covenant people set apart for Him.

**14:6** The battle instructors have taken their positions, and the army of His spirits marches under our banners. Our cavalry sweeps in like clouds along the horizon,

**14:7** like morning dew blanketing the ground. After the defeat of the Kittim, the entire community will stand on that battlefield

**14:8** and praise the God of Israel. Together they will declare: Praise the God of Israel, who keeps

**14:9** His faithful love for His covenant people and opens the way of salvation for those He has rescued! He called the weak and stumbling

**14:10** to experience miraculous deliverance. He gathered the nations for total destruction, to vindicate the discouraged

**14:11** and give the speechless a voice to sing praise. He trained feeble hands for war and strengthened trembling knees

**14:12** to stand firm. Through the humble in spirit You will judge the hard-hearted. Through those who live blamelessly,

**14:13** every wicked nation will meet its end. Not one of their warriors will survive. But we, the sur[vivors of Your people],

**14:14** will praise Your name, O God of compassion, who keeps the covenant with our ancestors. Through all our generations

**14:15** You have shown Your astonishing mercy to the sur[vivors of Your people] living under Belial's tyranny. Despite every secret weapon of his hatred,

**14:16** nothing has turned us from Your covenant. You drove his destructive spirits away from us. Even when the people

**14:17** who served him acted with treachery, You kept Your redeemed ones alive. You lifted up those who had fallen by Your power and brought down all who stood tall in pride. Their warriors have no one to save them and their fastest runners have nowhere to hide.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 14 is the post-battle prayer and thanksgiving. "Congregation of deceit" rendered as "assembly of liars" for immediacy. "Kittim" preserved as the recognized term for the eschatological enemy (Romans). Lines 14:8-13 reprise the column 12 hymn. "God of mercies" rendered as "God of compassion." The closing lines (14:16-17) vividly depict God's protection of the faithful under Belial's persecution.*
